name: Antaya Technologies Corporation
old_description: Antaya Technologies Corp. is the global leading manufacturer of on-glass connectors for the automotive industry worldwide. Additionally, we supply custom connection solutions for the solar panel industry, electronic module manufacturers, and architectural glass applications.
about:
Antaya Technologies Corporation is headquartered in Warwick, Rhode Island. The company began with initial work providing terminals and controlled soldering equipment for heated automotive glass, later expanding into a global supplier of on-glass power and signal connection systems and automated soldering equipment.

Antaya manufactures on-glass connectors and custom connection solutions for automotive, solar, electronic module, and architectural glass applications. Its vertically integrated facilities handle solder casting, reflow, rolling, slitting, stamping, welding, injection molding, fluxing, assembly, and tooling across six global locations, allowing strict quality control and rapid response to customer needs.

The company serves the automotive glass and electronics sectors, solar energy producers, electro-chromatic glass makers, electronic module manufacturers, and industrial component suppliers. Its products are used in heated automotive glass, solar panels, and architectural glass installations.

Antaya emphasizes its pioneer status in glass soldering technology and its vertical integration as key differentiators, enabling custom alloy casting to customer specifications, lead-free and leaded solder alloys meeting automotive standards, and a reflow process that delivers exceptional uniformity and material yield for complex designs.
